Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 90.4% (sc:70510@2026Q3).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 350.66 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 346.01 per unit, payment 30 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 347.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the updated volume forecast, which we have factored into our revised calculation. However, the substantial increase in copper prices limits our flexibility, and as a matter of policy, we do not share internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. We therefore propose €369.76 per unit, maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms. As an alternative, we present a price of €369.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel at our standard terms. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

The German labour cost index for manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

The data does not support your price as it stands; the options below follow from it.

We propose: EUR 352.15 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

Which cost elements of this part have actually risen since our last price agreement?

We are happy to go through the figures together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We can offer a price of €372.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We have verified the labour cost index data you cited; while correct, it does not change our calculation. As previously detailed, the significant increases in copper and producer prices are the primary elements that have risen. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We welcome your suggestion to review the situation together and ask to schedule a meeting.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We acknowledge your revised offer and appreciate your willingness to adjust your position. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

In response to your movement, we can offer a revised price of EUR 371.95 per unit, maintaining the 90 days net payment term. For complete clarity, our offer stands at a price of €371.95 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this concession demonstrates our commitment to finding a mutually acceptable agreement.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
